title: A certified refinement and asymptotic analysis of the Kuznetsov-Sahinidis diameter bound for Lennard-Jones clusters
summary: Kuznetsov and Sahinidis (J. Glob. Optim., 2025) prove distance bounds that confine optimal Lennard-Jones clusters and shrink the search region of deterministic solvers; their diameter bound charges each unit-width layer the loosest internal energy $-\binom{n}{2}$. We replace this by a certified estimate built from their own subset inequality and the proven minima $V_5^*$, $V_6^*$, and minimize the resulting layer bound over population profiles. Centred decreasing profiles supply candidate minima; an arrangement-free relaxation, whose only classical ingredient is the rearrangement inequality…
